digest.overview: Quiet window dominated by OpenAI's small acquisition and Anthropic's Claude Code update. Community chatter on hardware rumors and local model quants, but few high-signal developments.

top_story.headline: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
top_story.summary: NextSlide team now integrates into ChatGPT; no financial details disclosed.
top_story.why_it_matters: Adds presentation tooling to OpenAI's product stack amid ongoing model pushes like the rumored post-Astra 'Doug' model.

sentiment.label: mixed
sentiment.summary: Skepticism on Reddit about AI hype and capability claims; measured optimism from Simon Willison on agent tooling improvements.

frontier_labs.headline: Anthropic sets Claude Code auto mode as default for most plans
frontier_labs.summary: Auto mode becomes default Aug 14 for Pro/Max/Team; reflects confidence in reduced prompt injection risks per Simon Willison notes.

frontier_labs.headline: OpenAI acquires NextSlide
frontier_labs.summary: Presentation startup folded into ChatGPT team.

influencer_takes.author: Simon Willison
influencer_takes.quote: Wrote some notes on auto-mode on my blog - I REALLY want to believe that this fixes prompt injection risks for coding agents, but I'm just not there yet
influencer_takes.context: Direct commentary on Anthropic's Claude Code change and lingering safety concerns

influencer_takes.author: Yann LeCun
influencer_takes.quote: When you work on research (particularly on long-term research), you have to accept the fact that corporate management... may think you are wasting your time
influencer_takes.context: Broader view on balancing short-term product races with AGI-level conceptual advances

research_radar.headline: 73 NeurIPS workshops, zero on Causality
research_radar.summary: r/MachineLearning notes subfield sidelined by LLM/agent focus at major venues.

post_ideas.hook: OpenAI just bought a presentation tool—what does that say about their roadmap?
post_ideas.draft: OpenAI acquires NextSlide and folds the team into ChatGPT. Quiet move, but it signals they're serious about end-to-end productivity suites beyond chat.
post_ideas.why_viral: Contrarian take on acquisition as strategic signal rather than hype

post_ideas.hook: Anthropic defaults to auto mode in Claude Code despite prompt injection worries
post_ideas.draft: Anthropic is making auto mode the default in Claude Code starting Aug 14. Simon Willison isn't convinced it fully solves agent safety risks yet.
post_ideas.why_viral: Taps ongoing agent safety debate with specific expert quote

post_ideas.hook: RTX 5090 96GB spotted on Alibaba—real or vapor?
post_ideas.draft: r/LocalLLaMA buzzing over an alleged RTX 5090 96GB listing on Alibaba. If legit, local inference just got a massive hardware jump.
post_ideas.why_viral: Hardware rumor with high community tension and direct link
